name: gander-feed
description: Feeds the Gander dashboard exact per-session telemetry (context fill, rate-limit windows, cost, every model request, sub-agent spawns) and draws a one-line Gander band above the prompt. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer; Gander's classic hooks keep working without it.

band.description: Draw the one-line Gander band above the prompt (needs-you count, this session's spend, context fill).
band.title: Band above the prompt

pollSeconds.description: How often the band asks the bridge for the needs-you count.
pollSeconds.title: Band refresh (seconds)
